```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
```

```{python}
carpall_one = sc.read("1_carpall_soupx_corrected.h5ad")
```

# identify mito, ribo and hb genes
```{python}
carpall_one.var["mt"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
carpall_one.var["ribo"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.startswith(("RPS", "RPL"))
carpall_one.var["hb"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.contains(r"^HB[ABDEGMQZ]\d*(?!\w)")
```

```{python}
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
    carpall_one, qc_vars=["mt", "ribo", "hb"], inplace=True, percent_top=[20], log1p=True
)
carpall_one
```

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    nrows=5,
    ncols=1,
    figsize=(10, 12)
)

vars_ = ["pct_counts_mt", "pct_counts_ribo", "pct_counts_hb", "n_genes_by_counts", "total_counts"]
thresholds = {
    "pct_counts_mt": [25],
    "pct_counts_ribo": [40],
    "pct_counts_hb": [5],
    "n_genes_by_counts": [200,5000],
    "total_counts" : [100,10000]
}

for ax, var in zip(axes, vars_):

    sc.pl.violin(
        carpall_one,
        keys=var,
        groupby="Patient",
        stripplot=False,
        ax=ax,
        show=False
    )

    if var in thresholds:
        for t in thresholds[var]:
            ax.axhline(
                y=t,
                linestyle="--",
                linewidth=1,
                color="red"
            )

    ax.grid(False)

plt.tight_layout()

fig.savefig(
    "pre_qc_violins.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.close(fig)
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_one.obs["Patient"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

cell_counts.columns = ["Patient", "n_cells"]
cell_counts
cell_counts.to_csv("patient_cell_counts_pre_qc.csv")
```

```{python}
ax = cell_counts.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(10, 4))

ax.set_xlabel("Patient")

ax.set_title("Cells per Patient")

```

```{python}
carpall_one = carpall_one[(carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_mt'] < 25) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_ribo'] < 40) &
    (carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_hb'] < 10) &
    (carpall_one.obs['total_counts'] > 100) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['total_counts'] < 10000) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] > 200) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] < 5000), :].copy()
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_one.obs["Patient"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

cell_counts.columns = ["Patient", "n_cells"]
cell_counts
cell_counts.to_csv("patient_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
```

```{python}
pre = pd.read_csv("patient_cell_counts_pre_qc.csv")
pre = pre.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_pre"})
post = pd.read_csv("patient_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
post = post.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_post"})
cell_counts = pd.merge(pre, post, how = "inner")
cell_counts = cell_counts.drop(columns = "Unnamed: 0")
cell_counts = pd.melt(cell_counts, id_vars=["Patient"], var_name="qc_stage", value_name="n_cells")
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
plt.clf()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

sns.barplot(
    data=cell_counts,
    x="Patient",
    y="n_cells",
    hue="qc_stage",
    ax=ax
)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("cell_counts_filtering.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
carpall_one.X = carpall_one.layers['soupx_counts']
carpall_one.layers['counts'] = carpall_one.X.copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(carpall_one, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(carpall_one)
carpall_one.layers['logcounts'] = carpall_one.X.copy()
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_one.layers['counts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()

plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_one.layers['logcounts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obs["batch"] = (
    carpall_one.obs["file_id"]
    .str.extract(r"count_(\d+)_CAR")
)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    carpall_one, 
    n_top_genes=2000, 
    flavor="cell_ranger", 
    batch_key='batch', 
    layer = 'logcounts',
    subset = False
)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.pca(carpall_one, svd_solver="arpack", use_highly_variable=True)
plt.figure()
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(carpall_one, n_pcs=50, log=True)
plt.savefig("Elbow_plot.png", dpi=300)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(carpall_one, n_pcs=11)
sc.tl.umap(carpall_one, random_state=2026)
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(20,20))
sc.pl.umap(carpall_one, color=["batch", "Patient", "Timepoint_bin", "Sort"], 
wspace=0.5,show=True, size = 2, ncols=2)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("UMAP_uncorrected.png",dpi=300)
```

```{python}
carpall_hvg = carpall_one[:, carpall_one.var["highly_variable"]].copy()
carpall_hvg
```

```{python}
scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(carpall_hvg, layer="counts", batch_key="batch")
carpall_hvg
model_scvi = scvi.model.SCVI(carpall_hvg)
model_scvi
model_scvi.view_anndata_setup()
```

```{python}
max_epochs_scvi = np.min([round((20000 / carpall_one.n_obs) * 400), 400])
max_epochs_scvi
```

```{python}
model_scvi.train(accelerator="mps")
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obsm["X_scVI"] = model_scvi.get_latent_representation()
sc.pp.neighbors(carpall_one, use_rep="X_scVI")
sc.tl.umap(carpall_one)
```
